title: Concept: GraphQL introspection result disclosed in a response
description: A GraphQL introspection response returns the schema itself: every type, field, argument and deprecation. Publishing it removes the guesswork from writing queries against the API, including mutations the documentation does not mention.
applicability: Responses from a GraphQL endpoint that accepts introspection queries.
risk: The complete API schema is readable; MEDIUM severity because the schema maps the attack surface rather than exposing data directly.
